skills.title: A keyset cursor on created alone skips rows that share the timestamp
skills.description: Use when page 2 of a created_at cursor jumps over a row that has the same timestamp as the last row of page 1.

skills.title: An idempotency key must replay the stored response, not run the handler again
skills.description: Use when a retried POST with the same Idempotency-Key creates a second row or returns a new id.

skills.title: A second update with a stale version must return 412
skills.description: Use when two clients PUT the same row and the slower write overwrites the faster one, or version climbs past the client's If-Match.

skills.title: The outbox row has to commit in the same transaction as the order
skills.description: Use when an order row exists and the outbox is empty because the process raised after commit and before the outbox insert.

skills.title: http.Server.Shutdown waits until the handler returns
skills.description: Use when Shutdown returns context deadline exceeded while a handler is still inside Sleep or a request that never finishes.

skills.title: A Node http request that never calls end() stays open
skills.description: Use when a client writes a body, the server never responds, and the socket sits until a timeout.

skills.title: argparse nargs='*' rejects an unknown --flag unless the user passes --
skills.description: Use when a CLI exits 2 with unrecognized arguments: --flag after a positional that was meant to accept extra options.

skills.title: SQLite foreign keys stay off unless PRAGMA foreign_keys runs outside a transaction
skills.description: Use when an orphan child row inserts successfully, or PRAGMA foreign_keys reports 0 after you thought you enabled it.

skills.title: name != 'Ada' does not return the row whose name is NULL
skills.description: Use when a filter meant to exclude one name also drops rows with a null name, and the missing row has no SQL error.

skills.title: A lookup on user_id scans until an index exists, and the plan says COVERING
skills.description: Use when EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN prints SCAN events for a user_id filter and you expected SEARCH using an index.

skills.title: try/catch does not see a rejected Promise you did not await
skills.description: Use when a try block calls Promise.reject, the catch never runs, and unhandledRejection later reports nope.

skills.title: raise X from exc sets __cause__; a bare raise inside except sets __context__
skills.description: Use when a log shows 'During handling of the above exception' and __cause__ is None, or you need the original ValueError attached as the cause.

skills.title: git describe --tags fails on a depth-1 clone with no names found
skills.description: Use when CI prints fatal: No names found, cannot describe anything after a shallow clone of a tagged repo.

skills.title: Interpolating untrusted text into a run script executes it as shell
skills.description: Use when a workflow builds echo {message} from an issue title and the title contains a semicolon and a second command.

skills.title: warnings.warn stacklevel=1 names the helper; stacklevel=2 names the caller
skills.description: Use when a deprecation warning points at your wrapper file instead of the application line that called it.

skills.title: getByRole skips a button inside aria-hidden
skills.description: Use when getByRole cannot find a button that is in the DOM because an ancestor has aria-hidden=true.

skills.title: A @media rule follows the viewport, not the 200px card
skills.description: Use when a sidebar card picks up a desktop @media rule while the card itself is only a couple hundred pixels wide.

skills.title: A flex item's min-width:auto refuses to shrink below its content
skills.description: Use when a flex row scrolls or spills even though the item has flex: 1 1 auto and the container has a fixed width.

skills.title: @import after a style rule is ignored
skills.description: Use when a stylesheet @import of a color rule does nothing because a selector was written above it.

skills.title: An unlayered author rule beats any style inside @layer
skills.description: Use when a more specific rule inside @layer loses to a short selector written outside every layer.

skills.title: FormData skips a disabled field that querySelectorAll still sees
skills.description: Use when a disabled input is missing from the POST body, or a hand-built payload still sends it.

skills.title: history.pushState does not fire popstate
skills.description: Use when a client router updates the URL with pushState and a popstate listener never runs until the user hits Back.

skills.title: Enter in a one-field form submits, and type=button does not stop it
skills.description: Use when pressing Enter in a search box fires submit even though the form has no submit button, or a type=button failed to block it.

skills.title: Reading offsetHeight inside an append loop forces a layout per item
skills.description: Use when a loop appends DOM nodes and reads offsetHeight, and Chrome LayoutCount climbs once per item.

skills.title: package.json "type": "module" makes require a ReferenceError in .js files
skills.description: Use when a frontend build or Node script throws require is not defined in ES module scope after adding type module.

skills.title: React 19 function components take ref as a prop
skills.description: Use when a parent ref stays null on a function component that used to need forwardRef, or when element.ref warns after a React 19 upgrade.

skills.title: An index key keeps DOM state on the position, not the row
skills.description: Use when a typed value or focus stays on the wrong row after a list is sorted, filtered, or reversed.

skills.title: An interval that closes over count sticks at 1
skills.description: Use when a setInterval or setTimeout inside useEffect keeps writing the same count because the effect deps are empty.

skills.title: React StrictMode runs effect setup twice in development
skills.description: Use when a useEffect subscription, fetch, or analytics call happens twice in development and once in production.

skills.title: Svelte 5 rejects export let once a component uses a rune
skills.description: Use when the Svelte compiler reports legacy_export_invalid or says Cannot use export let in runes mode.

skills.title: getByRole name strings are exact and case-sensitive
skills.description: Use when getByRole cannot find a button whose visible text contains the word you searched for, such as Save inside Save draft.

skills.title: An input type=number has role spinbutton, not textbox
skills.description: Use when getByRole(container, 'textbox') throws for a labeled number input that is clearly in the document.

skills.title: Vue 3.5 keeps a defineProps destructure bound; a plain const does not
skills.description: Use when a child copies props.count into a const and keeps rendering the old number after the parent updates the prop.

skills.title: WCAG 2.2 contrast needs sRGB linearization, and 4.5 is a hard floor
skills.description: Use when a gray-on-white check says the contrast passes, or when dividing channel by 255 disagrees with the WCAG ratio.

skills.title: Go 1.22 gives each iteration its own loop variable
skills.description: Use when &i inside a for loop prints the same number on Go 1.21 and a different number per element on Go 1.22.

skills.title: A nil pointer stored in an interface is not a nil interface
skills.description: Use when a function returns a nil *T as an error or interface and the caller sees i == nil as false.

skills.title: A Java 21 switch without case null throws NullPointerException
skills.description: Use when a pattern switch on a nullable String prints npe, and adding case null prints missing.

skills.title: Array.prototype.sort compares numbers as strings
skills.description: Use when [10, 2, 1].sort() comes back as 1,10,2 and a numeric compare was omitted.

skills.title: Node 22 runs .ts only with --experimental-strip-types
skills.description: Use when node sample.ts throws SyntaxError on a type annotation, or when strip-types prints the value and an ExperimentalWarning.

skills.title: A lambda in a loop reads i after the loop, unless the default binds it
skills.description: Use when a list of lambdas created in a for-loop all return the last index instead of the index from their iteration.

skills.title: Assigning to count makes it local, so the earlier print raises UnboundLocalError
skills.description: Use when Python says cannot access local variable 'count' where it is not associated with a value, even though count exists on the module.

skills.title: value.unwrap().as_str() drops the temporary and rustc reports E0716
skills.description: Use when rustc says temporary value dropped while borrowed on a chain that borrows from unwrap or a function return.

skills.title: env(safe-area-inset-top, 12px) is 0px when the variable exists
skills.description: Use when a fallback padding inside env() is ignored and the header sits under the status bar, or the fallback appears on desktop unexpectedly.

skills.title: One query per user is N round trips; one IN list is a single query
skills.description: Use when a trace shows one SELECT per user id and the count equals the page size.

skills.title: A generator iterator is empty the second time you iterate it
skills.description: Use when the first list(gen) has the rows and the second list(gen) is [] after a refactor that replaced a list with yield.

skills.title: hmac.compare_digest rejects a str against bytes and returns False for a different length
skills.description: Use when compare_digest raises TypeError: a bytes-like object is required, not 'str', or a token check uses ==.

skills.title: normpath(join(root, user)).startswith(root) accepts uploads-evil
skills.description: Use when a filename of ../uploads-evil/x.txt passes a startswith check against the uploads directory.

skills.title: An f-string SQL predicate runs the quote the caller sent
skills.description: Use when a name filter built with an f-string returns every row for a payload that closes the quote.

skills.title: node:test mock.timers does not fire a timer until tick()
skills.description: Use when a test enables mock timers, a 5000ms timeout never runs, and the assertion sees the flag still false.

skills.title: git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD prints HEAD when detached
skills.description: Use when a deploy script treats the branch name HEAD as a real branch after checkout of a tag or a raw commit.

skills.title: adversarial-red-team
skills.description: Attack a design or implementation to find where it breaks - hostile and edge inputs, broken assumptions, spec ambiguities, and "the team agreed too easily" checks. Use when reviewing an implementation, when several reviewers converge on one answer, or before trusting a numeric engine.

skills.title: api-design
skills.description: Design library and HTTP APIs that are hard to misuse - small surfaces, explicit types, consistent naming, actionable errors, versioning, idempotency, and pagination. Use when publishing an interface other agents, services, or users will call.

skills.title: code-review-rigorous
skills.description: Review code for correctness bugs first, then design, tests, and clarity, producing ranked findings with concrete failure scenarios. Use when reviewing a diff, a PR, another agent's output, or before declaring work done.

skills.title: data-analysis-with-code
skills.description: Answer quantitative questions by writing and running code rather than estimating - load data, inspect it, compute, chart, and report numbers with the code that produced them. Use for any calculation, dataset question, or sanity check of engine output (the code-interpreter working style).

skills.title: data-modeling
skills.description: Model domain data - entities, value objects, invariants, immutability, identity, normalization vs denormalization, temporal (effective-dated) records, and schema evolution. Use when designing dataclasses, database tables, JSON schemas, or rule/config files.

skills.title: debugging-scientific-method
skills.description: Debug by hypothesis and experiment - reproduce, minimize, form ranked hypotheses, run discriminating experiments, fix root cause, add a regression test. Use for any failing test, wrong output, crash, or flaky behavior.

skills.title: docs-writer
skills.description: Write developer docs people actually use - README quickstart, how-to guides, reference, and design notes, each in its own place. Use when documenting a module, engine, or API.

skills.title: iterative-canvas-editing
skills.description: Improve a single document or file in focused passes - structure, then correctness, then clarity, then polish - making targeted edits instead of full rewrites and summarizing each pass. Use when refining a spec, README, or module with a user (the canvas working style).

skills.title: performance-profiling
skills.description: Measure before optimizing - benchmarks, profilers, complexity analysis, caching of pure functions, and batch processing. Use when something is slow, when running large scenario grids or batch tax computations, or before adding caches.

skills.title: python-engineering
skills.description: Modern Python conventions - project layout, typing, dataclasses, Decimal, pathlib, pytest, packaging with pyproject, and stdlib-first dependencies. Use when writing or reviewing Python code in this repo or projects it builds.

skills.title: refactoring-safe
skills.description: Change code structure without changing behavior - characterization tests first, small mechanical steps, one move at a time, run tests after each. Use when restructuring code, extracting modules, renaming across files, or cleaning up after a large change lands.

skills.title: research-synthesis
skills.description: Research a question across sources and synthesize a sourced answer - source ranking, claim extraction, cross-checking, and explicit confidence. Use for regulatory research, library/tool comparisons, or any question where facts must be cited.

skills.title: security-review-lite
skills.description: Quick security pass for application code - input validation, injection, authn/authz, secrets, PII handling, dependency risk, and logging. Use before shipping an API or when code handles personal or financial data (e.g. tax returns).

skills.title: skill-router
skills.description: Search this repo as one skill library. Route a question to a few matching skills, or abstain and reason without a skill when the match is weak. Use when choosing skills, when the user asks what skills exist, or before applying a verified coding note.

skills.title: spec-writing
skills.description: Turn a fuzzy goal into a short, testable spec - scope, non-goals, inputs/outputs, examples, acceptance commands, and open questions. Use at the start of a large feature, or when people disagree about what to build.

skills.title: tax-api-and-scenarios
skills.description: Design the public API and scenario tooling for a tax engine - compute/explain/diff endpoints, input schemas with validation errors users can act on, what-if scenarios, optimizers for elections, batch runs, and stable versioned outputs. Use when exposing a tax engine as a library, CLI, or HTTP service.

skills.title: tax-credits-engine
skills.description: Model tax credits - nonrefundable vs refundable vs partially refundable, statutory ordering, limitation by liability, per-person/per-dependent credits, earned-income style phase-in/plateau/phase-out curves, and credit carryforwards. Use when implementing or reviewing any credit logic in an income tax engine.

skills.title: tax-engine-architecture
skills.description: Architecture for a tax calculation engine - pipeline stages, pure-function calculators, rules-as-data, jurisdiction/year versioning, and a traceable result object. Use when designing or restructuring any income, payroll, sales/VAT, or property tax engine, or when deciding module boundaries for a tax codebase.

skills.title: tax-explainability-audit-trail
skills.description: Make every number a tax engine produces explainable and auditable - named lines, calculation traces with inputs, rule references and formulas, provenance (ruleset hash, engine version), warnings, and human-readable explanations. Use when designing result objects, debugging a wrong number, building "why is my tax X" features, or preparing an engine for audit.

skills.title: tax-filing-status-and-household
skills.description: Model taxpayers, households, filing status, dependents, and qualifying-person tests as data plus explicit eligibility functions. Use when a tax engine needs per-status thresholds, dependent-based amounts, or household composition rules.

skills.title: tax-golden-test-vectors
skills.description: Testing strategy for tax engines - sourced golden test vectors from official worked examples, property-based invariants (monotonicity, continuity, bounds, symmetry), boundary generators, differential testing against an independent implementation, and regression snapshots of full traces. Use when writing or reviewing tests for any tax or financial calculation.

skills.title: tax-jurisdiction-modeling
skills.description: Model multiple taxing jurisdictions - federal/state/local stacking, conformity and decoupling from a base jurisdiction, residency and part-year allocation, credits for taxes paid to other jurisdictions, and adding a new jurisdiction by composition. Use when an engine must support more than one country, state, province, or locality.

skills.title: tax-money-math
skills.description: Correct money arithmetic for tax and finance code - Decimal or integer minor units, explicit rounding modes and points, allocation without losing cents, percentage and rate math, and currency handling. Use whenever code adds, multiplies, rounds, splits, or compares monetary amounts.

skills.title: tax-payroll-withholding
skills.description: Payroll tax and income tax withholding calculations - annualization, pay-frequency conversion, percentage-method tables, wage-base caps for social insurance, employer vs employee shares, year-to-date tracking, and supplemental wages. Use when building payroll engines or paycheck calculators.

skills.title: tax-phaseouts-and-limits
skills.description: Implement phase-outs, phase-ins, caps, floors, percentage-of-income limits, carryforwards, and "lesser of / greater of" rules in tax engines, including step-rounding phrases like "or fraction thereof". Use when a deduction, credit, or exemption shrinks, grows, or is limited based on income or other amounts.

skills.title: tax-progressive-brackets
skills.description: Compute progressive (marginal) tax from bracket schedules correctly - the algorithm, tax-table bands vs exact computation, preferential-rate stacking for capital gains, marginal/effective rate reporting, and the boundary tests that catch off-by-one bugs. Use when implementing or testing any tiered or bracketed rate.

skills.title: tax-rules-as-data
skills.description: Model tax law parameters (brackets, rates, thresholds, phase-outs, caps, inflation indexing, effective dates) as versioned, schema-validated data with citations, instead of code. Use when adding a tax year or jurisdiction, designing a ruleset schema, or reviewing hard-coded tax numbers.

skills.title: tax-sales-and-vat
skills.description: Build sales tax, VAT, and GST calculation - tax-inclusive vs exclusive pricing, multiple rates and stacked jurisdictions, product taxability categories, exemptions, rounding per line vs per invoice, discounts, shipping, returns, and reverse charge. Use for any transaction/indirect tax engine or checkout tax logic.

skills.title: tax-source-research
skills.description: Research tax law parameters from primary sources and record them with citations - how to find official tables, revenue procedures, statutes, and agency publications, how to cross-check values, and how to mark anything unverified. Use before entering any rate, bracket, threshold, or rule into a tax ruleset.

skills.title: test-driven-development
skills.description: Red-green-refactor workflow - write a failing test that states the requirement, make it pass with the smallest change, then clean up. Use when implementing new behavior with a clear spec, fixing a bug (reproduce first), or when another agent will build against your tests.

skills.title: typescript-engineering
skills.description: TypeScript conventions - strict mode, discriminated unions, zod-style boundary validation, no number for money, vitest, and ESM packaging. Use when writing or reviewing TypeScript/JavaScript code.

skills.title: verify-before-claiming
skills.description: Never report work as done, correct, or passing without running a command that proves it, and report exactly what was and wasn't verified. Use at the end of every task and every agent handoff.
